narrative.overview: DuoShot presents the paired iPhone Duo screenshots as the product. A bright, quiet frame and graphite device forms make the content immediate. Marketing moves cinematically; the tool settles into clear task rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white studio and graphite ink
Geist hierarchy, mono only for data
Paired Harbor imagery as the central artifact
GSAP story on arrival, restrained transitions in the tool
Explicit checks and files before download

rules.name: Screens First
rules.body: The closed/open pair is the focal content across landing and workbench.

rules.name: Truth in the Report
rules.body: Separate technical checks, visual alerts and human confirmation without approval predictions.

rules.name: Motion Has a Job
rules.body: Use GSAP for the opening story and brief motion for state feedback; reduced motion keeps all content visible.

dos: Identify Harbor as a fictional demo.
Keep controls keyboard reachable and at least 2.85rem high.
Show image dimensions and filenames before download.
donts: Do not carry the previous cobalt and paper identity forward.
Do not imply direct App Store Connect upload.
Do not place decorative motion in the workbench.
